notes: `חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ` is rendered attributively (*his fierce anger*) rather than with *of*, so rule 28 governs and no relational word is placed.
The anticipatory *it is* of *it is in my heart* is construction-supplied and joins the prepositional predicate under rules 20 and 49.
The waw s012 takes the *that* the ASV writes for it under rule 14; rule 55's `added` case governs only a clause with no conjunction in it.
